checks.lead: Maryam bint Ibrahim al-’Attar (Arabic: مريم بنت إبراهيم العطّار) (1467 – 1493) also known as Morayma (مُرَيْمَةَ, lit. 'Little Maryam') (also Moraima, Murayma) was the last sultana of Granada as the spouse of Muhammad XI of Granada. She has been used as an inspiration by many authors and often portrayed within fiction.
